user.title: Choose an R2-D2 from Home Assistant Bluetooth
user.description: Select a cached device or enter its Bluetooth address. Home Assistant can use a local adapter or a compatible Bluetooth proxy. Setup does not connect or wake the droid; use Connect when ready. Choose the optional service setting only for an existing Mech API installation.

data.name: Friendly name
data.use_service: Use an existing Mech API service instead

service.title: Connect to the local controller service
service.description: Enter the service address and API token. This does not connect to or wake a droid.

error.incompatible_api: This integration requires Mech API v1.
error.invalid_url: Enter an HTTP(S) service URL without embedded credentials, query or fragment.
